text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Heh, thank you. Getting to spend<n>another birthday
with you two is all I<n>could ever ask for.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
If you think about it, you're Brian's<n>older sister, but
you're also the older<n>sister out of the three of us,
too!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I know! For the rest of the day,<n>I'm gonna call
you "big sis"!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you like that? You do, don't you?<n>Woohoo!
C'mon, you do it too,<n>Taishin!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Why nooot? You don't like "big sis"?<n>What about
just "sis"? "Big sister"?<n>"Dearest sister"?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
That's not what I mean! First of all,<n>why would "big
sis" be—
